_doc: The only test sets tools/dev/test.sh runs in parallel. Everything not listed here runs serially, as unittest
discover and go test run it. Add an entry only with a recorded equality run: the same tree once serially and once
split, `python3 tools/dev/results.py --same serial.json split.json` printing SAME, on a build host; put the run's
date, host, tree and the two result hashes in `evidence`.
python: {"<dir>/<module>.py": {"processes": N}}: the module's whole classes over N processes (pyrun.py --split).
c: C test variants run at the same time, N at once (crun.py -j); each variant has its own binary and TMPDIR.
